ev.ab_go_trade.title: A call from over the sea
ev.ab_go_trade.text: Merchants you know are leaving for foreign lands for a long time – there, they say, hands and goods have room to grow, while here everything is already divided up. They ask you along: "Settle in, then bring your family."
ev.ab_go_trade.all.ok: You sold the house and loaded the bundles. Behind you – everything familiar; ahead – a foreign tongue and hope.
ev.ab_go_trade.alone.ok: You left alone. Your family stayed behind to wait for news and money.
ev.ab_go_trade.stay.ok: The merchants left without you. Sometimes you wonder: what if…
ev.ab_go_service.title: Mercenary service
ev.ab_go_service.text: A recruiter from a foreign land is hiring strong people: service at court, pay in silver, maybe land in a few years. Your kind are valued there.
ev.ab_go_service.go.ok: You swore an oath to a foreign ruler. The road was long, and service began the very next day.
ev.ab_go_service.go_all.ok: The family followed you – the recruiter promised lodgings by the barracks.
ev.ab_go_service.stay.ok: The recruiter shrugged: there are plenty of takers without you.
ev.ab_flee_ruin.title: Fleeing disaster
ev.ab_flee_ruin.text: Only charred beams are left of the house, the field is ruined, and in town they say a new calamity is already on its way. Many are leaving for foreign lands – somewhere calmer.
ev.ab_flee_ruin.flee.ok: You left with what you could carry. No one was waiting for you on the other side – but at least it's quiet there.
ev.ab_flee_ruin.stay.ok: You stayed: your ancestors' graves are here, and here you'll live.
ev.ab_flee_debt.title: Escaping the debts
ev.ab_flee_debt.text: The creditors won't leave you alone, and they say the judge is already drawing up papers. Abroad, no one knows your debts.
ev.ab_flee_debt.flee.ok: You left at night without a goodbye. The debts stayed behind – no longer yours.
ev.ab_flee_debt.stay.ok: You decided not to run. It will be hard, but honest.
ev.ab_go_invited.title: An invitation from afar
ev.ab_go_invited.text: Word of your skill has reached a foreign court: they invite you to work there, promising good pay, a house and apprentices.
ev.ab_go_invited.all: Accept and go with the family
ev.ab_go_invited.all.ok: You were received with honor. Now your craft serves a foreign ruler.
ev.ab_go_invited.alone.ok: You went alone – "for a couple of years." We'll see how many it turns into.
ev.ab_go_invited.decline.ok: You declined. Masters are needed at home too.
ev.ab_go_marriage.title: A suitor from abroad
ev.ab_go_marriage.text: A foreign merchant asks for your hand: rich, no longer young, he will take you away to his own country. Your family says there won't be a better match.
ev.ab_go_marriage.accept.ok: The wedding was held by foreign rites. Your husband's house is far away and the language is strange, but now you are mistress of a house.
ev.ab_go_marriage.refuse.ok: The merchant left without a bride. Your family shook their heads for a long time.
ev.ab_go_faith.title: Staying by the holy places
ev.ab_go_faith.text: On pilgrimage you met a community of your fellow believers who live by the holy places abroad. They ask you to stay – to pray and to serve.
ev.ab_go_faith.stay_there.ok: You stayed. Home is now wherever people pray as you do.
ev.ab_go_faith.home.ok: You came home with a blessing and stories for a lifetime.
ev.ab_captive.title: Taken captive
ev.ab_captive.text: The raid struck at dawn. You were tied up together with your neighbors and driven south – to the sea, to the slave markets.
ev.ab_captive.endure.ok: You survived the road. Now you are a slave in a foreign land, but a living soul still hopes for something.
ev.ab_go_exile.title: Disgrace
ev.ab_go_exile.text: You have fallen out of favor: at court they whisper that it's time to bring you to heel – and not only with words. Friends advise you to leave while you can.
ev.ab_go_exile.exile.ok: You left with your family and what you could carry. Abroad you were received as a noble exile – with respect, but without lands.
ev.ab_go_exile.endure.success: The storm passed by: the ruler's anger turned to mercy.
ev.ab_go_exile.endure.failure: You lost part of your lands and were kept away from court for a long time.
ev.ab_culture_shock.title: Everything is foreign
ev.ab_culture_shock.text: They bake bread differently here, pray differently, laugh at different things. At the market you point with your finger because you lack the words. In the evening you want only one thing – to hear your own language.
ev.ab_language.title: A foreign language
ev.ab_language.text: Without the language you're like a mute here: they overcharge you at the market, the court won't listen, the neighbors laugh behind your back.
ev.ab_language.learn.ok: Word by word, mistake by mistake – within a year you were haggling at the market.
ev.ab_language.own.ok: It's easier among countrymen: your own words, your own jokes. But the world beyond the quarter stayed foreign.
ev.ab_neighbors_help.title: Neighbors
ev.ab_neighbors_help.text: When you were laid low with fever, a widowed neighbor brought you soup for a week and wouldn't take a coin. "We were all strangers here once," she said.
ev.ab_neighbors_hostile.title: "Go back to your own!"
ev.ab_neighbors_hostile.text: In the morning someone smeared the gate with mud: "No place for strangers here." The neighbors look away.
ev.ab_neighbors_hostile.endure: Bear it and wash it off
ev.ab_neighbors_hostile.endure.ok: You silently washed the gate. A month later the message hadn't come back.
ev.ab_neighbors_hostile.answer: Go to the head of the quarter
ev.ab_neighbors_hostile.answer.success: The headman shamed the culprits in front of everyone. People began to respect you – if not to love you.
ev.ab_neighbors_hostile.answer.failure: The headman spread his hands: "You understand – you're not from here."
ev.ab_guild.title: The guild and the stranger
ev.ab_guild.text: To work in the city you must join a guild. The masters look at you doubtfully: good hands, but a foreign accent.
ev.ab_guild.apply.success: They admitted you – with a probation period and a big fee. But now you're one of the masters.
ev.ab_guild.apply.failure: Refused: "We don't have room for our own." You'll have to work on the quiet and for less.
ev.ab_guild.aside.ok: You started working for your own countrymen – less money, but no bowing and scraping.
ev.ab_blamed.title: The stranger is always to blame
ev.ab_blamed.text: A neighbor's goat has gone missing, and the whole quarter already knows who took it: the foreigner, of course. The neighbor demands payment.
ev.ab_blamed.pay.ok: You paid for someone else's goat. A week later the goat came back on its own – but no one returned the money.
ev.ab_blamed.court.success: The judge turned out to be honest: the charge was dropped. For the first time the neighbors looked at you differently.
ev.ab_blamed.court.failure: The judge didn't even hear you out: "A stranger – so guilty." You had to pay double.
ev.ab_pogrom.title: Riot
ev.ab_pogrom.text: There's war with your homeland: a mob is roaming the city looking for "spies." Someone has already pointed at your house.
ev.ab_pogrom.hide.success: A local acquaintance hid you in a cellar for three days. The mob left empty-handed.
ev.ab_pogrom.hide.failure: They didn't find you, but the house was looted and set on fire.
ev.ab_pogrom.go_home.ok: You fled home with your family – with nothing, but alive.
ev.ab_letter_home.title: A letter from home
ev.ab_letter_home.text: A letter has come from {homeplace}: your family writes that they are getting old, that the house is empty without you, and they keep asking – when will you come back?
ev.ab_letter_money.title: Send money
ev.ab_letter_money.text: Your relatives back home write: a bad harvest, debts, they can't hold out without help. "You've grown rich there, haven't you" – reads between the lines.
ev.ab_letter_money.send.ok: You sent a heavy purse with a merchant. In return came a blessing – and a new request.
ev.ab_letter_money.refuse: Reply that you have nothing to spare
ev.ab_letter_money.refuse.ok: You wrote that it isn't easy for you either. No answer came – and that weighed more than any reproach.
ev.ab_parent_dying.title: News of your mother
ev.ab_parent_dying.text: They write from home: {npc} is very ill and keeps calling for you. The road is long – you may not make it in time.
ev.ab_parent_dying.go.ok: You dropped everything and set off for home.
ev.ab_parent_dying.money.ok: You sent money and a long letter. The answer came half a year later.
ev.ab_parent_dying.stay.ok: You stayed. You lie awake long into the night.
ev.ab_child_forgets.title: Forgetting the mother tongue
ev.ab_child_forgets.text: {npc} chatters with the neighbors' children just like a local, but mixes up words in your own language. It makes you both glad and sad.
ev.ab_teen_home.title: "I want to go home!"
ev.ab_teen_home.text: {npc} doesn't want to live here: no friends, a foreign language, the other kids laugh. "Send me to our relatives! That's my home!"
ev.ab_teen_home.send: Send them to relatives back home
ev.ab_teen_home.send.ok: {npc} left with a merchant caravan. Letters come rarely, but they are full of happiness.
ev.ab_teen_home.insist: Insist: our home is here now
ev.ab_teen_home.insist.ok: {npc} sat silent at the table for a long time. Then got used to it – or pretended to.
ev.ab_teen_home.all_home.ok: You all went back together. {npc} wept with joy at the gates of home.
ev.ab_community.title: Your own people abroad
ev.ab_community.text: The city has a quarter of your countrymen: their own church or mosque, their own market, their own speech. They invite you to live with them.
ev.ab_community.join.ok: Breathing is easier among your own. Only now you go out into the rest of the city less and less.
ev.ab_community.apart.ok: You stayed among the locals. It's hard – but you become one of them faster.
ev.ab_local_marriage.title: A local love
ev.ab_local_marriage.text: You keep stopping by one shop – and not for the goods. A local, a laughing glance, and the family doesn't seem to mind a foreigner.
ev.ab_local_marriage.marry.ok: The wedding followed local custom. Now you have not just a home here, but a family.
ev.ab_local_marriage.no.ok: You stopped going to that shop. Sometimes your heart argues.
ev.ab_success.title: Business takes off
ev.ab_success.text: Local merchants have started buying your goods, and your countrymen order from you. You know both worlds – and you profit from it.
ev.ab_homesick.title: Homesick
ev.ab_homesick.text: You dream of {homeplace} again: the smell of the stove, voices by the well, familiar faces. You've spent several years abroad now. Maybe it's time to go home?
ev.ab_homesick.return.ok: It's decided: home. Packing didn't take long.
ev.ab_homesick.stay.ok: You stayed. Life here is yours too.
ev.ab_homesick.later.ok: You didn't decide yet. The question won't go away.
ev.ab_naturalized.title: You belong here
ev.ab_naturalized.text: One day at the market someone asked where you were from – and you couldn't answer right away. Your home is here, your street, your people. Now you are a resident of this country.
ev.ab_return_shock.title: A stranger among your own
ev.ab_return_shock.text: At home nothing is as you remembered: the streets have grown narrower, the old folks older, your place at the table long since taken. They call you "the one from overseas" – not always kindly.
ev.ab_varangian.title: The Varangian Guard
ev.ab_varangian.text: Northerners with axes serve in Constantinople – the emperor's Varangian Guard. The commander heard your speech and invites you to join his men: imperial pay.
ev.ab_varangian.join.ok: Now you stand at the palace gates with an axe on your shoulder. The Greeks look at you warily – and with respect.
ev.ab_varangian.no.ok: You kept to your own trade.
ev.ab_frank_quarter.title: The Frankish yard
ev.ab_frank_quarter.text: The city has a funduq – a yard for Frankish merchants: warehouse, inn and chapel behind one gate. At night the gate is locked from the outside. Plenty of your own kind there, but little freedom.
ev.ab_greek_teacher.title: A teacher of Greek
ev.ab_greek_teacher.text: Italian scholars hunt for everything Greek: manuscripts, teachers, words. They ask you to give lessons – and pay generously.
ev.ab_greek_teacher.teach.ok: Your pupils copy Plato and argue until they're hoarse. You are needed here.
ev.ab_hansa_court.title: The German court
ev.ab_hansa_court.text: In Novgorod the German merchants live in their own court by St. Peter's church: their own statutes, their own scales, their own court of law. Russian neighbors trade with you willingly, but don't come inside.
ev.ab_rus_monastery.title: A Russian cloister
ev.ab_rus_monastery.text: In Constantinople Russian merchants and monks live by St. Mamas, and on Mount Athos there is a Russian monastery. Familiar prayers are sung there – and for a moment it feels like home.
ev.ab_captive.escape.success: At night you wore the rope through on a stone and slipped away into the steppe. A month later, barely alive, you reached your own people.
ev.ab_captive.escape.failure: They caught you and beat you. You reached the slave market barely alive – and were sold across the sea.
